item.title: FDA Advisory Committee Decisions
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA's Oncology Advisory Committee voted against a new paradigm in an AstraZeneca trial, and also rejected the company's camizestrant, an oral SERD. Additionally, the FDA ended a nine-month hiatus of advisory committee meetings with a narrow restart.
  • MoAs: Camizestrant: selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD)
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Endpoints News, BioSpace

item.title: Supreme Court Skinny Labeling
item.description:
• Summary: The U.S. Supreme Court heard arguments on skinny labeling, questioning how far generic drug makers can carve out protected indications to avoid patent infringement. The case involves AstraZeneca and has broad implications for generic competition and patent law.

item.title: Obesity Drug Development and Policy
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA proposed a new rule to end compounding of GLP-1 drugs, potentially impacting patient access. A novel five-way obesity drug showed super-effective results in mice, targeting multiple receptors. A new tool called Obscore was developed to assess obesity health risks beyond BMI.

item.title: FDA Personnel and Regulatory Actions
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA named Katherine Szarama as acting director of the Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER). Amarox recalled a batch of antidepressants due to a manufacturing and labeling issue. Bayer received an FDA untitled letter for Nubeqa (darolutamide) advertisements lacking risk information. A patient death prompted the FDA to pause Newron's Phase 3 schizophrenia study.
  • MoAs: Nubeqa (darolutamide): androgen receptor inhibitor. Other drugs not specified.
  • Sources: STAT News, Fierce Pharma, Fierce Pharma, BioSpace
